item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure over the South China Sea, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong today. With the subtropical ridge strengthening slightly, the weather will be very hot over southeastern China in the latter part of this week. The area of low pressure now near the Philippines may weaken gradually today. The broad trough of low pressure over the South China Sea will edge closer to the coast of southern China early next week, there will be more showers with thunderstorms over the region.
